words.ladder_sign: you don't know this story yet

rooms.name: The gap
rooms.hint: Pinch, step back: E takes the idea. Drift across on the current. Pinch over the far floor.

rooms.name: The soft wall
rooms.hint: Drift through the soft wall. Pinch on the far side; one jump up to the exit.

rooms.name: The goat
rooms.hint: Wait for the goat and let it carry you over. Pinch above the far floor.

rooms.name: The climb
rooms.hint: Climb pinched; asleep, the wind takes you. The top is a step too high: Q makes one.

rooms.name: The maze
rooms.hint: Drift into the current; it lifts you through the soft walls. Pinch over the island, not before.

rooms.name: Cold water
rooms.hint: The water takes you pinched. Ride the goat; pinch above the beam on its way back.

rooms.name: The draft
rooms.hint: Drift right; the draft lifts you. Pinch over the shelf: the idea. Ride up to the perch.

rooms.name: The ladder
rooms.hint: It goes up to somewhere you have not been. Not tonight. Walk on, pinched.

rooms.name: Your bed
rooms.hint: E at the bed: wake gently with everything. Dealt early, the exit past it is the bet.

rooms.name: The Long House, below
rooms.hint: Two ways down; the signs say whose dream lies each way. Pinch, and walk into one.

rooms.name: Tove's room
rooms.hint: Tove sleeps here. E at the idea, pinched: the night ends with it and every thought.

rooms.name: Jorun's room
rooms.hint: Jorun sleeps here. E at the idea, pinched: the night ends with it and every thought.

rooms.name: Bo's room
rooms.hint: Bo sleeps here. E at the idea, pinched: the night ends with it and every thought.
